notes: Adds speaker-feedback protection for the Voice Controller using browser echo cancellation plus server playback-aware gating. YouTube requests now select and start a canonical result automatically, with a validated official host-browser fallback when no dashboard player is available or embedding/autoplay is blocked. Adds official playlist playback and continuous embedded queue advancement until a media-qualified stop command. Dashboard state distinguishes embedded and host-browser modes and disables controls that cannot affect an external tab.
